E01.name: Low contact point
E01.cue: Move into position and aim for contact above and in front of your shoulder.

E02.name: Contact point behind the shoulder
E02.cue: Turn side-on and keep the contact point in front of your body.

E03.name: Elbow not raised during preparation
E03.cue: Raise your elbow as you prepare the swing.

E04.name: Limited swing extension
E04.cue: Let your upper arm and forearm extend through the swing.

E05.name: Limited wrist movement at contact
E05.cue: Use a relaxed wrist and coordinate forearm rotation through contact.

E06.name: Limited body rotation
E06.cue: Let the hips lead the shoulders through the swing.

E07.name: Excessive vertical body movement
E07.cue: Keep your center of gravity steady through contact.

E08.name: Lunge knee beyond the toe reference
E08.cue: Check your lunge alignment and keep the movement controlled and comfortable.

E09.name: Shallow lunge
E09.cue: Move closer to the shuttle and lower into a controlled lunge.

E10.name: Serve contact above the hip reference
E10.cue: Review the serve contact height relative to your hips; this pose check is not an officiating decision.

E11.name: Uneven shoulder-elbow-wrist timing
E11.cue: Connect the leg drive, body rotation, arm swing and wrist movement smoothly.

E12.name: Limited recovery after contact
E12.cue: Recover toward your ready position after the swing.

E13.name: Stance width outside the reference range
E13.cue: Set a balanced ready stance around shoulder width.

E14.name: Non-racket arm held low
E14.cue: Use your non-racket arm to help maintain balance.

E15.name: Jump pattern outside the reference range
E15.cue: Review your takeoff and contact timing for the selected shot.

E01.name: Low shooting release
E01.cue: Extend the shooting arm and aim for a release above and in front of your head.

E02.name: Limited wrist follow-through
E02.cue: Let your wrist follow through, with fingers pointing toward the basket.

E03.name: Shooting elbow flared outward
E03.cue: Bring your shooting elbow into line with the basket.

E04.name: Low release angle
E04.cue: Review your upward arm path through the release.

E05.name: Forward or backward lean at release
E05.cue: Keep your body balanced through takeoff and release.

E06.name: Limited jump height
E06.cue: Coordinate a controlled leg drive with the shot.

E07.name: Limited knee bend
E07.cue: Bend your knees and hips before driving upward.

E08.name: Uneven two-foot takeoff
E08.cue: Keep both feet coordinated for a balanced takeoff and landing.

E09.name: Stiff dribbling wrist
E09.cue: Guide the ball with relaxed fingers and wrist movement.

E10.name: Dribble above the hip reference
E10.cue: Lower the dribble toward hip level or below.

E11.name: Head down or chest rounded
E11.cue: Keep your head up and look ahead while controlling the ball.

E12.name: Limited knee lift during layup
E12.cue: Coordinate the knee drive with your layup steps.

E13.name: High center of gravity
E13.cue: Bend your knees and lower your hips into a stable stance.

E14.name: Stance width outside the reference range
E14.cue: Keep your feet around shoulder width for balance.

E15.name: Excessive lateral body movement
E15.cue: Keep your center of gravity balanced between your feet.

E01.name: Support-foot position outside the reference range
E01.cue: Review the support-foot position beside the ball and its alignment with your target.

E02.name: Straight support knee
E02.cue: Keep a slight, comfortable bend in the support knee.

E03.name: Excessive forward or backward lean
E03.cue: Keep your torso controlled through contact.

E04.name: Limited kicking-leg swing
E04.cue: Use a controlled backswing and forward swing.

E05.name: Low kicking-leg speed
E05.cue: Coordinate the hip and leg swing smoothly through contact.

E06.name: Unstable support foot
E06.cue: Keep the support foot planted through contact.

E07.name: High center of gravity
E07.cue: Lower your hips and bend your knees before contact.

E08.name: Uneven shoulder line
E08.cue: Keep your shoulders balanced instead of leaning sideways.

E09.name: Limited cushioning during ball control
E09.cue: Let the receiving foot move with the ball to soften contact.

E10.name: Large leg swing during juggling
E10.cue: Use smaller, controlled touches while juggling.

E11.name: Uneven juggling rhythm
E11.cue: Aim for consistent touch timing and height.

E12.name: Limited follow-through
E12.cue: Let the kicking leg follow through after contact.

E13.name: Head down toward the ball
E13.cue: Look ahead and use peripheral vision to track the ball.

E14.name: Stance width outside the reference range
E14.cue: Use a balanced stance around shoulder width.

E15.name: Arms held close to the body
E15.cue: Let your arms help balance the movement.

E01.name: Bent elbows during forearm pass
E01.cue: Keep both arms together and extend the elbows to form a steady platform.

E02.name: Forearm-pass contact height outside the reference range
E02.cue: Keep the passing platform in front of your waist.

E03.name: Contact point away from the body centerline
E03.cue: Move into position so the ball is in front of your body.

E04.name: Low serve toss
E04.cue: Practice a steady upward toss in front of your hitting shoulder.

E05.name: Low serve contact point
E05.cue: Reach above and in front of your head for contact.

E06.name: Limited jump during spike
E06.cue: Coordinate the approach and a controlled takeoff with the spike.

E07.name: Low spike contact point
E07.cue: Reach upward and keep the contact point in front of your head.

E08.name: Low arm-swing speed
E08.cue: Coordinate the upper arm, forearm and wrist through the swing.

E09.name: Blocking hands below head level
E09.cue: Extend both arms above your head for the block.

E10.name: Limited jump during block
E10.cue: Review the takeoff and reach during your block.

E11.name: Limited knee bend
E11.cue: Bend your knees before moving or jumping.

E12.name: Torso lean outside the reference range
E12.cue: Keep a balanced ready position with a slight forward lean.

E13.name: Stance width outside the reference range
E13.cue: Set a stable ready stance around shoulder width.

E14.name: Excessive vertical body movement
E14.cue: Keep your center of gravity steady through the pass.

E15.name: Hands separated during forearm pass
E15.cue: Bring your hands together to create a stable passing platform.

E01.name: Rounded upper-body posture
E01.cue: Keep your chest open, shoulders relaxed and gaze forward.

E02.name: Hands held too high
E02.cue: Keep the rope handles near the sides of your hips.

E03.name: Arms spread too wide
E03.cue: Keep the upper arms close to your sides and turn the rope with your wrists.

E04.name: Limited ground-contact transition
E04.cue: Allow a light, controlled landing between jumps.

E05.name: Limited jump clearance
E05.cue: Use a small, controlled jump with enough clearance for the rope.

E06.name: Limited clearance for double unders
E06.cue: Build enough controlled jump clearance for two rope turns.

E07.name: Stiff landing
E07.cue: Land softly with a slight bend in your knees.

E08.name: Uneven jump rhythm
E08.cue: Aim for consistent intervals between jumps.

E09.name: Abrupt pace change
E09.cue: Increase or decrease your pace gradually.

E10.name: Uneven two-foot takeoff
E10.cue: Coordinate both feet through takeoff and landing.

E11.name: Limited knee bend
E11.cue: Keep a small, springy bend in your knees.

E12.name: Side-to-side upper-body sway
E12.cue: Keep your torso centered as you jump.

E13.name: Head down toward the feet
E13.cue: Look forward and track the rope with peripheral vision.

E14.name: Rope-turn and jump rhythm mismatch
E14.cue: Match the rope turns to each jump; double unders use two turns per jump.

E15.name: Large arm movement instead of wrist turns
E15.cue: Use small wrist movements instead of wide arm circles.
